paper_metadata.title: Changes in the Corticospinal Tract Beyond the Ischemic Lesion Following Acute Hemispheric Stroke: A Diffusion Kurtosis Imaging Study

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study clearly defines the target population, recruitment setting, and specific inclusion/exclusion criteria. While it is a single-center study, the prospective recruitment and detailed baseline characteristics limit selection bias.

items.reasoning: The imaging parameters and the mathematical model for DKI are explicitly defined.

items.reasoning: Standardized software and preprocessing steps (eddy current correction) were used to ensure data quality.

items.reasoning: The analytical steps for both imaging and clinical data are well-described.
